bio.text: Steve Parsons is the Libertarian Party candidate for Arkansas's 1st Congressional District in 2026, having advanced from the party's February 22, 2026 convention.
According to his campaign website, he moved to Lakeview, Arkansas, in 2016, holds a Ph.D. in economics, and is a retired consultant.
The site says he was an adjunct professor at Washington University in St. Louis for over 20 years, teaching the economics of technology to graduate engineering students.
